title: Version 1.21.0
body:
Version 1.21.0

July 10th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added Borderless Conveyors!
  • Added WMI Vinyl (can only be obtained if you owned a WMI gramophone)

Changes:

  • WMI Gramophone now works in the same way as the Vinyl player
  • Petrified Oak is now a LOT easier to cut
  • Increased sell price of Fungoidite
  • Increased sell price of Fungiviolet
  • Increased maximum length (X) of Elevators by 1.5x
  • Increased maximum height (Y) of Garage Doors by 1.5x
